events.text: Heße was appointed Deputy Vicar General of the Archdiocese of Cologne.
events.subject: self
events.object: Deputy Vicar General of the Archdiocese of Cologne
events.quote: On 1 May 2006 , Heße was appointed Deputy Vicar General of the Archdiocese of Cologne .

events.subject: self
events.quote: On March 16 , 2012 , he became Vicar General .

events.text: Cardinal Joachim Miesner resigned as Archbishop of Cologne.
events.subject: other
events.quote: On 28 February 2014 , Cardinal Joachim Miesner , Archbishop of Cologne , resigned

events.text: Cardinal Rainer Maria Woelki was installed as Archbishop of Cologne.
events.subject: other
events.quote: On 20 September 2014 , Cardinal Rainer Maria Woelki was installed as Archbishop of Cologne .

events.text: Heße was reaffirmed as Vicar General.
events.subject: self
events.quote: At the ceremony , Heße was reaffirmed as Vicar General .
